title_sq: Shite apartament 2+1+2 me Post Parkimi tek Spring Residence !

Sipërfaqe neto: 96 m²

title_en: 2+1+2 apartment for sale with Parking Post at Spring Residence!
description_en: In one of the most elite and sought-after areas of Tirana, Vasil Shanto, a 2+1 apartment is offered for sale located in the Spring Residence residential complex, a new construction with contemporary standards. Gross area: 112.5 m² Net area: 96 m² Functional and modern organization includes: Spacious living room with natural lighting and integrated kitchen 2 comfortable bedrooms 2 toilets 1 balcony Distribution corridor 🏢 The apartment is located on the 4th floor, in a newly completed building, with high quality construction and well-managed facilities. 📄 In the mortgage process 🚗 1 parking spot included in the price Price: €350,000 Ideal as a family residence or long-term investment, thanks to the premium location, quick access to the center and surrounding facilities (schools, offices, services, transport). Ideal for residence or investment, thanks to the premium location and the constant demand for this area.
